authority: external review / user ruling 2026-09-16, item 4 (final localized-error protocol decision)

supersedes.note: the calibration record is evidence and is not rewritten; this file carries the decision that closes it

decision.summary: For d >= 2 the failure signature sLocalizedError fires exactly when the localized-error acceptance criterion preregistered for that problem in its ScientificSpec FAILS. For Poisson-2D that criterion is AC2D-9.
decision.noEmpiricalNullRequired: The ruling does NOT require fitting a new d >= 2 heuristic threshold from an empirical null distribution before the next experiment; the acceptance criterion carries the requirement instead.
decision.researchOnlyStatus: diagnostics and calibration research; none of them is a formal FailureSignature gate

retired.rule: max block RMS error / median block RMS error > 3.0
retired.evidence: fires on 9/10 seeds of the fully validated run exp2d-poisson-calibration-r1 (statistic 2.946-4.815)
retired.reported: still computed and reported beside the trigger as retiredStatistic, never acted on

trigger.statisticDefinition: max over tiles of sqrt(mean_tile (u_theta - u*)^2) / sqrt(mean_set (u*)^2)
trigger.aggregation: per seed against the criterion, then the criterion's seedPolicy ('every-seed' for a MUST criterion, the same rule Gate 5b applies): one failing seed is already an acceptance failure and fires the symptom. The median is retained as a reported statistic only.
trigger.claimSetUse: forbidden: D_claim is opened once for acceptance and is never read for diagnosis or adaptive tuning
trigger.thresholdSource: the acceptance threshold of the named criterion in the problem's acceptance contract; the symptom may not carry a bound of its own
trigger.independentOfGlobalMetrics: the trigger does not read relL2: a run whose global metric passes and whose localized criterion fails still fires the signature
trigger.invalidEvidence: fail closed (ValidationInputError); invalid evidence is never read as evidence of no localized failure

preregistrationRequirement.when: before the formal run; the configuration is part of the run's code identity, so a criterion added later cannot reach a completed run
preregistrationRequirement.failClosed: a d >= 2 run whose signatureCriteria carry no localized acceptance criterion raises at diagnosis time instead of running without the symptom

exampleForPoisson2D.note: every field is verified against pinn/governance/poisson2d_contract.py localized_criterion('AC2D-9')

notAppliedRetroactively.reason: its frozen configuration preregistered the inherited 1D symptom rule, not this trigger; introducing a criterion now and pointing it at that run is exactly the post-hoc retrofit this protocol forbids
notAppliedRetroactively.machineCheck: pinn.experiments2d.localized_error.assert_criterion_within_run_identity compares the configuration's bytes against the run's recorded codeManifest
notAppliedRetroactively.effectOnC2: none: AC2D-9 was evaluated as a MUST acceptance criterion in Gate 5b of that run and passed on all ten seeds (worst 1.568e-4 against 1e-3)

governanceClassification.reason: only the trigger of a symptom criterion changes, and symptom criteria live in the protocol and in each experiment's preregistered signatureCriteria

implementation.diagnostics: pinn/experiments2d/diagnostics2d.py emits maxTileRmsErrorOverReferenceRms per seed on D_dev
implementation.runner: pinn/experiments2d/runner2d.py phase_failure applies the d >= 2 trigger after observed_signatures

hardening.review: external review of the exported source package (commit 33dc22b), 2026-09-16

findings.seedAggregation: the median-based ensemble rule stayed silent while a minority of seeds failed the criterion (reproduced: 1/10 and 4/10 failing seeds both left fired=False)
findings.invalidEvidence: NaN / -Inf / negative statistics returned fired=False, and unequal array lengths were silently truncated by zip, dropping the tail of the error field
findings.criterionBinding: a localized statistic could be checked against AC2D-2's looser threshold because only the criterion id and the threshold were validated

resolution.seedAggregation: the verdict now uses the criterion's own seed policy -- 'every-seed', the policy Gate 5b already applies to MUST criteria -- and the record keeps perSeedValues, failingSeedIndices, failureCount, failureFraction and the ensemble statistics
resolution.invalidEvidence: fail closed via the repository's ValidationInputError: finite and non-negative statistics, equal array lengths asserted before any zip, non-empty evidence, homogeneous point dimension >= 2, coordinates inside the unit domain, blocksPerAxis >= 1, non-vanishing reference
resolution.criterionBinding: one source of truth: pinn.governance.poisson2d_contract.localized_criterion() resolves criterionId -> statisticId, normalization, partitionKind, tilesPerAxis, operator, threshold, level, seedPolicy; every preregistered field is checked against it
